title: BAROGROOVE Component Catalog
description: BAROGROOVE - your sky has a soundtrack. A weather-driven playlist engine. One UI definition, two surfaces: the Flutter app is an A2UI renderer pointed at this catalog, and the MCP server emits the identical JSON.

Stack.title: Stack
Stack.description: The single layout primitive. A vertical (or horizontal) run of children with house spacing. BAROGROOVE declares its own container rather than depending on the basic catalog, so the Flutter renderer can load this catalog alone and still draw every surface.

children.description: Child components, array form or list template.

padding.description: Spacing token applied on all sides.

maxWidth.description: Max content width in logical pixels.

barogroove.design: Executive layout: one column, generous section gaps, capped width.

Notice.title: Notice
Notice.description: Degradation and failure, stated plainly. BAROGROOVE never shows a spinner-turned-blank: if the sky read failed or a provider is down, the user is told what is missing and what still worked.

detail.description: Optional technical detail, collapsed by default.

degraded.description: Named capabilities that are unavailable right now.

barogroove.purpose: Degradation and failure, stated plainly. BAROGROOVE never shows a spinner-turned-blank: if the sky read failed or a provider is down, the user is told what is missing and what still worked.
barogroove.design: Critical uses criticalSoft fill with criticalInk text; never red-on-red.

SkyDial.title: SkyDial
SkyDial.description: Radial reading of the nine SkyVector dimensions -- WEIGHTED, not equal. pressure_trend_6h is the hero: it owns the needle, the display-size readout and the caption. The remaining derivative dimensions form the inner ring at full stroke; the absolute state dimensions (sun elevation, cloud depth, precipitation) sit dimmed on a thin outer ring. Weather is felt as CHANGE, so the derivatives get the ink.

heroLabel.description: Human label for the hero dimension.

heroValue.description: Hero value normalised to -1..1 for the needle.

spokes.description: Template ChildList over the sky dimension array. One SkyDialSpoke per dimension; the template form keeps N out of the component tree.

stale.description: True when the reading is older than the TTL.

notes.description: Provider notes attached to the reading.

onDimensionTap.description: Ask the agent to explain one dimension's contribution. Dispatches `barogroove.explainDimension`.

barogroove.purpose: Radial reading of the nine SkyVector dimensions -- WEIGHTED, not equal. pressure_trend_6h is the hero: it owns the needle, the display-size readout and the caption. The remaining derivative dimensions form the inner ring at full stroke; the absolute state dimensions (sun elevation, cloud depth, precipitation) sit dimmed on a thin outer ring. Weather is felt as CHANGE, so the derivatives get the ink.
barogroove.design: Needle in accent; hero readout in display type with tabular numerals; outer state ring at 45% opacity in inkSubtle. Stale readings get a gold hairline, not a red one -- stale is not an error.

ThemeChips.title: ThemeChips
ThemeChips.description: AXIS 1 OF 2. Selectable chips for the eight weather themes, each carrying its own palette so the chip previews the register it will put the whole surface into. Selection fires callAgentFunction, so the chips genuinely talk back to the agent rather than mutating local state the agent never hears about.

GenreCorridor.title: GenreCorridor
GenreCorridor.description: AXIS 2 OF 2, and visibly separate from the theme chips. The whole point of BAROGROOVE is that 'Petrichor x krautrock' is a CROSSING of two independent knobs: the sky picks the mood, you pick the vocabulary. Rendered as its own bordered panel with its own axis label and an explicit crossing readout ('Petrichor x krautrock'), so nobody mistakes genre for a sub-option of theme. Corridor width is a second-order control: how far the sky is allowed to drag the selection away from the corridor's anchor.

options.description: Template ChildList over the genre corridor array.

onForge.description: Commit the crossing and forge. Dispatches `barogroove.forge`.

TrackList.title: TrackList
TrackList.description: The ordered playlist as an ARC, not a bag. Every row carries its arc role badge (opener / build / peak / descent / closer) and its own `why`, because a track's position is a claim the engine is making and the user is entitled to see the claim. Rows come from a template ChildList over the bound track array -- the component tree stays a fixed handful of nodes no matter how long the playlist is.

rows.description: Template ChildList over the track array.

showWhy.description: Show the per-track rationale line (default true).

RationaleCard.title: RationaleCard
RationaleCard.description: THE HERO CARD. In BAROGROOVE the explanation is the product, not a footnote: a playlist you cannot interrogate is just a shuffle with better marketing. So the rationale is rendered FIRST, at display type, above the track list, with the sky reading and the sonic moves spelled out as separate evidence lists and the confidence stated as a number. Degradation is shown here too, in the same card -- if the engine had to guess, it says so where you are already looking.

headline.description: One sentence: what the sky did to the music.

skyReading.description: Evidence bullets drawn from the sky vector.

sonicMoves.description: What the engine did to the sonic target.

tasteNote.description: How the user's history bent the result.

onExplainDimension.description: Drill into one sky dimension from the evidence list. Dispatches `barogroove.explainDimension`.

barogroove.design: Gold hairline rule above the headline -- the only gold on the surface. Display type headline, body at 15/23, evidence lists at caption size in inkMuted. Confidence as a numeral, never a vague adjective alone.

barogroove.selectTheme.description: The user picked a weather theme chip. Re-target the sonic vector toward that theme's bias and re-render the theme/genre surface.

barogroove.selectGenre.description: The user moved the genre corridor. This axis is ORTHOGONAL to theme: changing it must not reset the selected theme.

barogroove.setCorridorWidth.description: Widen or narrow the genre corridor: 0 hugs the anchor, 1 lets the sky pull the selection anywhere inside the corridor's tags.

barogroove.trackFeedback.description: Loved / skipped feedback on one track. Feeds taste affinity for the next forge; never mutates the playlist currently on screen.

barogroove.forge.description: Commit the current theme x genre crossing and forge a playlist from the live sky vector.

barogroove.explainDimension.description: The user tapped a spoke on the SkyDial. Return the sentence that explains how that dimension moved the sonic target. The explanation is a first-class feature, so every dimension is interrogable.

barogroove.openAlmanacEntry.description: Re-open a past forge from the almanac timeline.

barogroove.refreshSky.description: Re-read the sky for a coordinate pair and update the dial.

barogroove.retry.description: Retry whatever failed on an error surface.

barogroove.openTelemetryTrace.description: Open a detailed trace inspection view for a recorded AI trajectory.

barogroove.refreshTelemetry.description: Refresh the live AI Observability Telemetry Inspector surface.

barogroove.scrollToTrack.description: Agent -> renderer: bring a track into view (used when the agent answers 'why is #7 there?' and wants the row highlighted).

barogroove.formatSigned.description: Client-side formatter for derivative readouts: renders a signed value with a unit and a fixed number of digits, e.g. '-9.2 hPa/6h'. Used as a Dynamic* FunctionCall so the sign convention lives in the catalog rather than in every builder.

barogroove.designIntent: Professional, executive-level, high-contrast, clean; EHDS portal register - Slate structure, Sky Blue action, subtle Gold accent. Light mode default. Explicitly not neon.

themeIntent.petrichor: Pressure is falling and rain is close. Wet slate-green, held low.
themeIntent.first_frost: Clear, cold and bright. The coldest blue in the system.
themeIntent.high_pressure_blue: A settled high. The unmodified house palette.
themeIntent.gale_warning: Gusts spiking, pressure collapsing. Urgent, not alarming.
themeIntent.golden_hour: Sun low, light long. The one theme where gold leads.
themeIntent.blanket_grey: Deep cloud, flat pressure. Lowest chroma; typography carries it.
themeIntent.heat_shimmer: Far above the norm, air standing still. Dry heat, not tropics.
themeIntent.long_dusk: Daylight shrinking fast. Muted violet-slate, reflective.
